summary: A deals pipeline board that shows the money total of each column next to its count, keeping the stage colour rail, title and count that a custom header would replace.
use: Sales pipelines, invoicing stages and any board where each column needs an aggregate (sum, weight, hours) beside the card count.
spec: `.kb-totals { display: flex; height: 22rem; }` is the board-height parent, a scoped class
